prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A dramatic close-up shot capturing the precise moment a large, gleaming cleaver strikes a coconut on a wooden surface. The composition is tight, focusing on the lower half of the cleaver’s blade as it makes contact, sending shards of coconut shell and a spray of clear coconut water flying in all directions. The lighting is bright and directional, highlighting the metallic sheen of the blade and the glistening droplets in midair, while casting subtle reflections and shadows on the wood below. The background is softly blurred, drawing attention to the dynamic action and the textures of the coconut fibers and splintered shell. The color palette is natural and earthy, dominated by the silvery steel of the cleaver, the warm browns of the coconut and wood, and the translucent whites of the water droplets. The overall style is cinematic and high-definition, with a shallow depth of field and a sense of frozen motion, evoking the intensity and precision of a high-speed food preparation scene.
